sample_size_rule:
M5b calibration on development seeds 310-312 only (never used for evaluation; distinct from v0.5 calibration seeds).

Usage: python tools/calibrate_m5b.py OUT_DIR BASE_SETTINGS_JSON
Decision rules (declared here, before running):
1. Mentorship schedule. Candidates (cohort_ticks, overlap) = (60, 30), then (80, 40). Choose the FIRST candidate under
   which at least one cross-generation lesson whose workflow has a non-empty dependency closure is acquired across the
   three calibration seeds (teaching-only condition). If none qualifies, choose the last candidate and report that no
   dependency lesson completed in calibration. The chosen schedule is used for every mentorship condition.
2. Sample size. Estimate evaluation runtime as (allocation conditions + mentorship conditions) x N x mean world seconds
   x 1.2; choose the largest N in (10, 8, 6, 5) whose estimate is at most 45 minutes.
Nothing here is tuned on outcome quality; the allocation runs only check that every condition completes and measure cost.

mentorship_schedule_decision.note: a dependency lesson was acquired under this schedule in calibration

selection_rules.freeze: lowest validation score among admitted or superseded workflows (components excluded); ties by creation tick then id
selection_rules.held_best: held by the cohort's members at its freeze
selection_rules.created_upto_best: created by this or earlier cohorts by the freeze tick (creation attribution)

allocation.primary: final held_best sealed-3 score: beam-alloc vs beam, paired by seed, separately for preserved and reset
allocation.identifies: the bundle's combined effect, not each guard's

primary: dependency lessons: eligible transitions, offered, acquired, failed, interrupted; dependencies acquired; independent post-retirement execution
final held_best sealed-3: teaching-only vs none
secondary: library vs none, library vs teaching-only

experiments.validation_panels: infrastructure implemented and tested; experiment deferred (not run)

missing_data: a direction is reported only if at least 75% of expected worlds are eligible pairs AND the same side is lower in at least 75% of eligible pairs; otherwise 'no consistent difference' or 'insufficient eligible pairs'. Descriptive, not a significance test. Missing selections are never scored as zero; failed worlds are reported and excluded from pairs with the reason.
stopping_and_exclusion: all planned worlds run; no early stopping; no world excluded except as failed (recorded)
no_tuning_after_freeze: settings, policies, seeds and rules above are fixed; sealed-3 scores are computed only after every run is closed
